# Viral product hook clips from product photos with Seedance 2.5

**Product photos become a 5–15 s hook that looks like phone footage: backyard-camera fail, torture test, problem then fix.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_49236bae5f94.webp" alt="A phone-style close-up hook: a hand trims a ginger cat's claw with a glowing LED nail clipper on a fluffy blanket." width="480"></p>

Makes the first 5-15 seconds of a product video, the part that stops the scroll: either finds a hook that already went viral for this kind of product (TikTok Creative Center, ad spy tools, Reels search) and remakes the idea, or generates a realistic UGC-style clip of the product in use with Seedance 2.5 on varg from the product's own photos (a backyard-camera fail, a torture test, problem then solution, a satisfying close-up, a gift reaction), or the whole "The problem → Vs → The solution" music ad. Use when someone selling a product (dropshipping, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon) asks for a viral hook, a scroll-stopper, a "TikTok made me buy it" clip, product b-roll that looks like real footage, or "a video of my product in use" made from product photos. Not for the full guide reel with the laptop and pen (use varg-dropship-reel, which calls this skill for its hook), talking-head UGC ads with an actor reading a script (find one with video-skills), or studio packshot spins (use varg-ai).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-product-hook                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-product-hook --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 5–15 s 9:16 hook clip |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$2.31 per 6 s 720p Seedance 2.5 clip (tested) |

## Ask your agent

- "Make a backyard-camera style hook for my snake-proof gaiters from ./gaiters.jpg, 9:16"
- "Turn my cat harness photos into a 'The problem → Vs → The solution' reel, 18 seconds, music only"
- "Find a hook that already went viral for pet nail clippers and remake it with my product"
